title: 6.5 Exponential Growth and Decay

icans: I can identify and write exponential growth and decay functions.
I can find the percent rate of change of an exponential function.
I can solve real-life problems, including compound interest.

vocab: y = a(1 + r)ᵗ: a quantity ____________ by the same percent each time period
y = a(1 − r)ᵗ: a quantity ____________ by the same percent each time period

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Reading the model: a is the _______________, and r is the _______________ written as a decimal.

blocks.stem: For y = 500(1.06)ᵗ, identify the initial amount and the rate of growth. Evaluate when t = 3.

notes: Growth and decay factors: The growth factor is _______________; the decay factor is _______________.

blocks.stem:
Does each function show growth or decay? Find the percent rate of change.
a.  y = 50(0.8)ᵗ        b.  y = 10(1.035)ᵗ
A $9,000 deposit earns 6% annual interest compounded semiannually. Write a function for the balance and find it after 5 years.
A $2,000 laptop loses 20% of its value each year. Write a function and find its value after 3 years.

tickets.stem: Does y = 80(1.15)ᵗ show growth or decay? What is the percent rate?
A town of 5,000 people decreases by 2% each year. Write a function for its population after t years.
